what_this_is: THE 137 REGISTRATIONS THE COMPLETE SEARCH RETURNED, NAMED. colchicine_search_COMPLETE.json records that the search returned 137 records over two pages and DOES NOT NAME ONE OF THEM. That is P30: a count stated in a record with no file anything can recompute from is indistinguishable from a count that was asserted. The screen below cannot be checked against a set that was never written down, and re-running the query later would silently substitute a different set. This file is that set.
re_executed: The query in colchicine_search_COMPLETE.json was re-executed on 2026-08-19 to obtain these identifiers. It returned the same totals: page 1 count=100 total=137 with a live next_page_token, page 2 count=37 total=null next_page_token=null. 100 + 37 = 137 == totalCount.
query_as_executed: intervention="colchicine"; condition="coronary artery disease OR myocardial infarction OR cardiovascular disease OR stroke OR atherosclerosis"; study_type=INTERVENTIONAL; page_size=100; count_total=true

recall_against_the_object_s_included_set.note: Two further trials the page's AUTO_INCLUDE list names -- LoDoCo2 and COPS -- are registered on ANZCTR and not on ClinicalTrials.gov, so this registry search CANNOT surface them and their absence is not a recall failure of this query. It is a limit of the database, and it is why a PubMed limb is owed on this topic.

A_DUPLICATE_REGISTRATION_IS_PRESENT_IN_T.evidence: Both are titled EXACTLY 'Post-Ablation Pericarditis Reduction Study', both sponsored by St. Vincent Cardiovascular Research Institute, both enrolment 248, both start 2021-05-20, both primary completion 2022-01-30, both COMPLETED, both intervention ['Colchicine'].
A_DUPLICATE_REGISTRATION_IS_PRESENT_IN_T.why_it_matters: P8 keys every trial to a registration id. TWO REGISTRATION IDS FOR ONE TRIAL BREAK THAT KEY IN THE DIRECTION THAT ADDS: a screen that dispositions by NCT id counts this study twice, and every downstream k inherits it. 137 registrations is therefore NOT 137 studies, and no arithmetic in this run may treat the two as interchangeable with the count of distinct trials.
A_DUPLICATE_REGISTRATION_IS_PRESENT_IN_T.handling: Both are screened. Whichever disposition they receive, they receive the SAME one, and the reading that would include them includes ONE. Recorded, not silently deduplicated.

counts.distinct_STUDIES: 136 at most -- see A_DUPLICATE_REGISTRATION_IS_PRESENT_IN_THE_SURFACED_SET. 137 is a count of REGISTRATIONS and this file never calls it a count of studies.
